Set in a quiet, elevated area of the property, this suite offers a unique experience surrounded by nature and tranquility.</p><p>It features a spacious traditional palapa roof, a fully equipped kitchen, a King bed, and open spaces designed for relaxation while enjoying the ocean breeze.<br>Perfect for guests seeking privacy, natural beauty, and an unforgettable stay.</p></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/rooms/palapa-sky-suite.html">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div></div></div></div><a class="left carousel-control" href="#room-types-promo-carousel" role="button" data-slide="prev"><span class="icon-prev" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="sr-only">Previous</span></a><a class="right carousel-control" href="#room-types-promo-carousel" role="button" data-slide="next"><span class="icon-next" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="sr-only">Next</span></a></div></div></div><div class="standard-promo about-us-promo"><div class="container"><h3 class="standard-promo-header">About Us</h3><p></p><p>We are the ideal destination to enjoy outdoor activities and the tranquility of El Sargento and La Ventana, emerging as a new tourist hotspot in Baja California Sur, Mexico. Visitors are drawn to the serene natural beauty of the area and the abundance of recreational opportunities available.</p><p>If you're passionate about outdoor adventures and connecting with nature, Sargento and La Ventana offer an array of experiences for an unforgettable vacation. Dive into the crystal-clear waters, reel in a big catch while fishing, explore vibrant marine life through snorkeling, or hit the trails for exhilarating mountain biking and hiking. Additionally, kayaking, paddleboarding, kiteboarding, and wing foiling are among the thrilling water sports options – La Ventana is renowned as one of Mexico's premier destinations for these activities.</p><p>Located just 45 minutes from the city of La Paz, our destination and its surrounding natural wonders offer an exciting and adventurous getaway.</p><p>Book your stay with us and immerse yourself in the breathtaking sunrises and sunsets.</p><p>Our resort features a restaurant and a terrace boasting the best views of Cerralvo Island. Renamed in honor of the renowned French oceanographer Jacques-Yves Cousteau on November 17, 2009, Cerralvo Island was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2005, as part of the Islands and Protected Areas of the Gulf of California.</p><p>We look forward to welcoming you!</p><p></p><br><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/about-us.html">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="standard-promo-container container"><div class="standard-promo local-attractions-promo"><h3 class="standard-promo-header">Attractions</h3><div id="local-attractions-promo-carousel" class="standard-promo-carousel carousel slide" data-ride="carousel" data-interval="false"><div class="carousel-inner" role="listbox"><div class="item active"><div class="row"><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-image"><img src="//webbox.imgix.net/images/norzbpnpqujtgmkx/afe0b58a-cb17-400c-acfe-436ad6091e93.jpg?auto=format,compress&amp;fit=crop&amp;crop=entropy&amp;w=750&amp;h=600" alt="" style="width: 100%"></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-info"><h4 class="standard-promo-title">Isla Cerralvo (Jacques Cousteau Island) Experience</h4><div class="standard-promo-description"><p>Located just off the coast of La Ventana and El Sargento, Isla Cerralvo—also known as <strong>Jacques Cousteau Island</strong>—is one of the most spectacular natural attractions in the Sea of Cortez. The island is renowned for its crystal-clear waters, abundant marine life, pristine beaches, and excellent conditions for ocean activities.</p><p>We can arrange customized excursions based on your interests, including:</p><ul><li>Snorkeling</li><li>Scuba Diving</li><li>Freediving</li><li>Sport Fishing</li><li>Spearfishing</li><li>Private Boat Tours</li><li>Wildlife Viewing and Beach Exploration</li></ul><p><strong>Seasonal Highlights</strong></p><p>Depending on the time of year, visitors may encounter:</p><ul><li>Sea lion colonies</li><li>Dolphins</li><li>Mobula rays</li><li>Sea turtles</li><li>Tropical reef fish</li><li>Whales (seasonal)</li><li>Whale sharks (seasonal)</li><li>Large pelagic species such as tuna, dorado, and yellowtail</li><li>Exceptional underwater visibility for diving and freediving</li></ul><p>Each excursion can be tailored to your experience level and preferences. Pricing varies depending on the activity selected, the number of participants, boat size, equipment requirements, guide services, and trip duration.</p><p>Please let us know:</p><ul><li>Which activity interests you most</li><li>Number of participants</li><li>Preferred date</li><li>Experience level (beginner or advanced)</li></ul><p>Our concierge&nbsp; will be happy to provide the best options and a personalized quote for your adventure to Isla Cerralvo.</p></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/attractions.html">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div></div></div><div class="item "><div class="row"><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-image"><img src="//webbox.imgix.net/images/norzbpnpqujtgmkx/ef885b75-ef3c-4297-a035-488631a439fa.jpeg?auto=format,compress&amp;fit=crop&amp;crop=entropy&amp;w=750&amp;h=600" alt="" style="width: 100%"></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-info"><h4 class="standard-promo-title">Espíritu Santo Island &amp; La Paz Adventure Experience</h4><div class="standard-promo-description"><p>Located just north of La Paz, <strong>Espíritu Santo Island</strong> is one of Mexico's most spectacular natural treasures and a UNESCO-protected area within the Sea of Cortez. Known for its turquoise waters, white-sand beaches, dramatic volcanic landscapes, and extraordinary marine life, it offers unforgettable experiences for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.</p><p>We can arrange customized excursions based on your interests, including:</p><ul><li>Swimming with Whale Sharks (seasonal)</li><li>Snorkeling with Sea Lions</li><li>Private Boat Tours</li><li>Scuba Diving</li><li>Freediving</li><li>Kayaking</li><li>Paddle Boarding</li><li>Wildlife Observation</li><li>Hiking and Nature Exploration</li><li>Sunset Cruises</li><li>Sandboarding at El Mogote Dunes</li><li>City Tours and Cultural Experiences in La Paz</li></ul><p><strong>Seasonal Highlights</strong></p><p>Depending on the time of year, visitors may encounter:</p><ul><li>Whale Sharks (typically October through April)</li><li>Sea Lion Colonies</li><li>Dolphins</li><li>Sea Turtles</li><li>Mobula Rays</li><li>Tropical Reef Fish</li><li>Humpback Whales (seasonal)</li><li>Crystal-clear waters with excellent visibility</li></ul><p>Visitors can also enjoy some of the region's most famous beaches, including:</p><ul><li>Balandra Beach</li><li>El Tecolote Beach</li><li>Ensenada Grande</li><li>Playa Candelero</li><li>Playa La Bonanza</li><li>El Coromuel</li></ul><p>Each excursion can be tailored to your interests, schedule, and activity level. Pricing varies depending on the selected activities, number of participants, transportation requirements, boat type, equipment rental, guide services, and tour duration.</p><p>Please let us know:</p><ul><li>Which activities interest you most</li><li>Number of participants</li><li>Preferred date</li><li>Experience level (beginner or advanced)</li></ul><p>Our concierge team will be happy to recommend the best options and provide a personalized quote for your adventure in La Paz and Espíritu Santo Island.</p></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/attractions.html">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div></div></div><div class="item "><div class="row"><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-image"></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-info"><h4 class="standard-promo-title">Discover El Triunfo – A Historic Mining Town in Baja California Sur</h4><div class="standard-promo-description"><p>Located approximately one hour from La Ventana and El Sargento, <strong>El Triunfo</strong> is one of Baja California Sur's most charming and historic destinations. Once a thriving mining town during the gold and silver boom of the 19th century, today it offers visitors a unique blend of history, culture, architecture, local cuisine, and art.</p><p>A visit to El Triunfo is perfect for those looking to experience a different side of Baja California Sur while enjoying a relaxing day trip through the mountains and desert landscapes.</p><p><strong>Things to See and Do in El Triunfo</strong></p><ul><li>Visit the iconic <strong>La Ramona Chimney</strong>, the town's most recognizable landmark and a symbol of Baja California Sur's mining history.</li><li>Explore the <strong>Mining History Museum (Museo Ruta de Plata)</strong> and learn about the fascinating gold and silver mining era that shaped the region.</li><li>Visit the <strong>Music Museum (Museo de la Música)</strong>, home to an impressive collection of restored pianos and historical musical instruments.</li><li>Discover the <strong>Museo Vaquero de las Californias</strong>, where visitors can learn about the traditions, culture, and heritage of the Baja cowboys who helped shape the history of the peninsula.</li><li>Walk through the historic town center and admire its beautifully preserved architecture.</li><li>Browse local artisan shops, galleries, and boutiques featuring regional crafts and artwork.</li><li>Enjoy scenic views of the surrounding mountains, desert landscapes, and historic mining structures.</li></ul><p><strong>Local Restaurants and Cafés</strong></p><p>Visitors can enjoy some of the area's most popular dining spots, including:</p><ul><li><strong>Margery's Tea Room</strong> – Famous for its homemade desserts, traditional English teas, and delicious lunch menu.</li><li><strong>Café El Triunfo</strong> – A cozy stop for coffee, breakfast, pastries, and local specialties.</li><li>Seasonal restaurants and artisan food vendors offering regional Baja cuisine and fresh local ingredients.</li></ul><p><strong>Perfect for a Day Trip</strong></p><p>El Triunfo can easily be combined with visits to nearby communities and attractions such as:</p><ul><li>San Antonio</li><li>Santiago</li><li>Miraflores</li><li>Los Barriles</li></ul><p>Whether you are interested in history, culture, photography, architecture, gastronomy, or simply enjoying a peaceful afternoon in a beautiful setting, El Triunfo offers a memorable experience for visitors of all ages.</p></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/attractions.html">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div></div></div><div class="item "><div class="row"><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-image"></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-info"><h4 class="standard-promo-title">Discover Todos Santos – Baja California Sur's Magical Town</h4><div class="standard-promo-description"><p>Located approximately one hour and thirty minutes from La Ventana and El Sargento, <strong>Todos Santos</strong> is one of Baja California Sur's most beloved destinations. Designated as a <em>Pueblo Mágico</em> (Magical Town), it is known for its vibrant art scene, historic architecture, beautiful beaches, local cuisine, and relaxed Baja lifestyle.</p><p>Nestled between the Sierra de la Laguna mountains and the Pacific Ocean, Todos Santos offers a unique blend of culture, nature, gastronomy, and adventure.</p><p><strong>Things to See and Do in Todos Santos</strong></p><ul><li>Stroll through the colorful historic downtown filled with art galleries, boutiques, and artisan shops.</li><li>Visit the iconic <strong>Hotel California</strong>, famous for its history and charming atmosphere.</li><li>Explore local art galleries featuring works by Mexican and international artists.</li><li>Visit the <strong>Cultural Center of Todos Santos</strong> and learn about the town's history and traditions.</li><li>Walk through the historic mission area and admire the colonial architecture.</li><li>Browse local markets featuring handmade crafts, jewelry, textiles, and organic products.</li><li>Enjoy seasonal festivals, live music, and cultural events throughout the year.</li></ul><p><strong>Beaches and Outdoor Activities</strong></p><p>Todos Santos is home to some of the most beautiful Pacific beaches in Baja California Sur:</p><ul><li><strong>Playa Cerritos</strong> – Popular for swimming, surfing, and beachside dining.</li><li><strong>Playa San Pedrito</strong> – A favorite destination for experienced surfers.</li><li><strong>Playa Los Esteros</strong> – Ideal for birdwatching and nature lovers.</li><li><strong>Punta Lobos</strong> – Known for its scenic coastal views and local fishing traditions.</li></ul><p>Visitors can also enjoy:</p><ul><li>Surfing lessons</li><li>Whale watching (seasonal)</li><li>Hiking and nature walks</li><li>Birdwatching</li><li>Mountain biking</li><li>Photography tours</li><li>Yoga and wellness experiences</li></ul><p><strong>Restaurants, Cafés, and Local Cuisine</strong></p><p>Todos Santos is considered one of Baja California Sur's premier culinary destinations. Popular options include:</p><ul><li><strong>Jazamango</strong> – Farm-to-table cuisine created by renowned Chef Javier Plascencia.</li><li><strong>Oystera</strong> – Fresh seafood and Baja-inspired dishes.</li><li><strong>La Esquina Café</strong> – A local favorite for breakfast, coffee, and healthy options.</li><li><strong>Baja Beans Roasting Company</strong> – Famous for locally roasted coffee and pastries.</li><li><strong>Hotel California Restaurant</strong> – Traditional Mexican and international cuisine in a beautiful courtyard setting.</li></ul><p><strong>Perfect for a Day Trip</strong></p><p>A visit to Todos Santos can easily be combined with nearby attractions such as:</p><ul><li>Playa Cerritos</li><li>El Pescadero</li><li>Sierra de la Laguna</li><li>Pacific Coast scenic viewpoints</li></ul><p>Whether you are interested in art, culture, gastronomy, surfing, shopping, photography, or simply enjoying a relaxing day by the Pacific Ocean, Todos Santos offers an unforgettable Baja California Sur experience.</p><p>Please let us know if you would like transportation, a guided tour, restaurant recommendations, or assistance planning the perfect day in Todos Santos. Our concierge team will be happy to help create a personalized itinerary.</p></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/attractions.html">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div></div></div><div class="item "><div class="row"><div class="hidden-xs col-sm-1"></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-image"></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-5"><div class="standard-promo-info"><h4 class="standard-promo-title">Mountain Biking &amp; Hiking Trails in La Ventana and El Sargento</h4><div class="standard-promo-description"><p>La Ventana and El Sargento are home to one of Baja California Sur's most extensive trail networks, offering spectacular routes for both hiking and mountain biking. With stunning views of the Sea of Cortez, desert landscapes, and mountain scenery, the area has become a favorite destination for outdoor enthusiasts from around the world.</p><p>Whether you are looking for a leisurely nature walk or an advanced mountain bike adventure, there are trails suitable for all skill levels.</p><p><strong>Northern Trail Network</strong></p><p>The northern trails offer a mix of scenic coastal viewpoints, rolling desert terrain, and technical mountain biking routes.</p><p>Popular highlights include:</p><ul><li>Coastal overlook trails with panoramic views of Cerralvo Island.</li><li>Desert singletrack routes through giant cacti and native vegetation.</li><li>Intermediate and advanced mountain biking loops.</li><li>Sunrise and sunset hiking routes.</li><li>Wildlife observation opportunities.</li></ul><p>These trails are ideal for riders and hikers seeking longer adventures and breathtaking views of the Sea of Cortez.</p><p><strong>Southern Trail Network</strong></p><p>The southern trail system features a variety of routes ranging from beginner-friendly paths to more technical climbs and descents.</p><p>Popular highlights include:</p><ul><li>Scenic ridge trails overlooking La Ventana Bay.</li><li>Technical mountain bike descents.</li><li>Family-friendly hiking routes.</li><li>Desert and mountain landscapes.</li><li>Access to secluded viewpoints and hidden canyons.</li></ul><p>Many of the southern trails provide excellent opportunities for photography and birdwatching.</p><p><strong>Activities Available</strong></p><ul><li>Mountain Biking</li><li>E-Mountain Biking</li><li>Hiking</li><li>Trail Running</li><li>Guided Nature Walks</li><li>Photography Tours</li><li>Sunrise and Sunset Excursions</li></ul><p><strong>Trail Difficulty Levels</strong></p><ul><li>Beginner</li><li>Intermediate</li><li>Advanced</li><li>Expert Technical Routes</li></ul><p><strong>What You May See Along the Trails</strong></p><ul><li>Cardón and Organ Pipe Cacti</li><li>Desert wildlife and birds</li><li>Seasonal wildflowers</li><li>Panoramic views of the Sea of Cortez</li><li>Cerralvo (Jacques Cousteau) Island</li><li>Coastal and mountain landscapes unique to Baja California Sur</li></ul><p><strong>Guided Tours and Rentals</strong></p><p>Our concierge team can assist with:</p><ul><li>Guided hiking tours</li><li>Mountain bike rentals</li><li>E-bike rentals</li><li>Trail maps apps, and recommendations</li><li>Customized outdoor adventures</li></ul><p>Please let us know your experience level, preferred activity, and the number of participants, and we will be happy to recommend the best trails and arrange a personalized outdoor experience company during your stay in La Ventana and El Sargento.</p></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/attractions.html">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="hidden-xs
